metadata.description: Self-hosted marketplace for the claude-statusbar plugin. Local hardened fork — no upstream URLs, no auto-update. The plugin wires the statusLine + slash commands; the render engine is the local `cs` CLI (install from source only).

plugins.name: claude-statusbar
plugins.description: Lightweight Claude Code status-line monitor: 5h/7d rate-limit usage, reset timers, projection/forecast, model + context window, prompt-cache countdown, optional session cost, project/branch (+ahead/behind), and an opt-in live-activity line (todos / active tool / subagents / session stats). 3 styles x 9 themes.
